tableSchemas.description: Pointer-to-map so PATCH can distinguish omit-and-preserve (nil) from replace-with-empty.

servedPath.description:
ServedPath is the worker-relative path a serve-capable agent's output is
served at (e.g. "/artifacts/<runId>/"); ServedURL is the absolute,
browser-openable URL the API composes from it (worker base + path) so a
client can surface the built app's link. Both empty for non-serving runs.

gasChainField.description: Payload field whose value is the gas-paying chain ID (dynamic; consulted when GasChainID is 0). E.g. "srcChainId" for cross-chain actions where the user signs and pays gas on the source chain.

gasChainId.description: Chain ID where gas is needed (static)

requiresGas.description: Whether action requires gas (blockchain transaction fees)

entryNodeIds.description: Subset of ExpandedIDs that are entry points

expandedIds.description: All namespaced node IDs produced by expansion

github_com_b3-fun_b3-mono_services_b3os-.description:
BlockContext is set on nodes that were expanded from a block.
It traces the node back to its source block and carries the inputMapping
needed to resolve {{$inputs.key}} references at execution time.

blockNodeId.description: Original block node ID in the workflow

description.description: Human-readable description for the variable picker

key.description: Output field name exposed to consumers

properties.description: Nested schema for object/array outputs (shown in variable picker)

sourceField.description: Field path from the source node's result (e.g., "balance")

sourceNode.description: Node ID within the block definition

adjusted.description:
Net of period adjustments (credit +, debit -, incl. monthly reset) so the
breakdown reconciles: granted + deposited + adjusted - used.

defaultOnly.description:
DefaultOnly indicates that this connector type is managed entirely by the platform.
Users cannot create their own connector instances; actions always use platform credentials.

optional.description:
Optional indicates if the connector can be omitted when required by an action.
If true, workflow nodes can have a null connector and the action will execute
without connector data (b3os-actions handles fallback if needed).

provider.description:
Provider indicates the underlying provider for this connector.
For Pipedream connectors, this is "pipedream".

providerConfig.description:
ProviderConfig contains provider-specific configuration.
For Pipedream connectors, this includes appSlug, authPropName, authType.

setupGuide.description: SetupGuide contains markdown instructions for setting up the connector.

nameTemplate.description: Display name with {{field}} interpolation (uses result field names, i.e. left side of FieldMapping)

github_com_b3-fun_b3-mono_services_b3os-.description: nil if action doesn't need connector

walletAddress.description:
WalletAddress is the wallet's on-chain address, only meaningful for
type:"wallet" refs. Not used by ConnectorResolver (which resolves the
address from the wallet DB record); exists for frontend round-trip fidelity.

walletSupport.description: Wallet account types this action supports (e.g., ["eoa"]). Nil = all types allowed.

contractCode.description: Main contract Solidity source (flattened or with imports)

files.description:
Multi-file project support
Key: relative path (e.g., "src/interfaces/IERC20.sol")
Value: file content

verificationUrl.description: URL to view verified contract on block explorer

verified.description: Whether contract source is verified on block explorer

github_com_b3-fun_b3-mono_services_b3os-.description:
Deployments is populated from the contract_deployments table, NOT from a DB column.
Kept for backward-compatible JSON serialization in API responses.

input.description: Input payload at time of completion/failure (may be raw or resolved)

iterations.description:
For for-each nodes only: tracks execution state of each iteration.
Each iteration is a mini ExecutionState graph (nodeID → ExecutionNode).

secretKeys.description: Input keys that contain connector secrets (for masking)

x-enum-comments.ExecutionNodeStatusAutoSwapping: Set when auto-swap is executing to cover a balance deficit
x-enum-comments.ExecutionNodeStatusCancelled: Set when run is cancelled by user
x-enum-comments.ExecutionNodeStatusPartial: Set when a for-each node completes with mixed iteration outcomes (some succeeded, some failed)
x-enum-comments.ExecutionNodeStatusPending: Set when run is created (all non-root nodes start as pending)
x-enum-comments.ExecutionNodeStatusScheduled: Set when node is scheduled for future execution
x-enum-comments.ExecutionNodeStatusSkipped: Set when node is skipped (e.g., non-taken if branch)
x-enum-comments.ExecutionNodeStatusSuccess: Set when node execution completes successfully
x-enum-comments.ExecutionNodeStatusWaiting: Set when node is paused waiting for a trigger

parentNodeId.description:
Legacy fields kept for backward-compatible JSON deserialization.
New code should only use Stack.

stack.description:
Stack holds nesting levels from outermost to innermost.
Single-level for-each uses a stack of length 1.

bucketStart.description: Start of time bucket (hourly or daily)

maxSwapAmountUsd.description:
MaxSwapAmountUsd caps the output USD value per individual swap.
Zero means no limit. Default is $3. Prevents a misconfigured action
from draining the entire source wallet in a single swap.

mode.description:
Mode controls how sources are selected. See AutoSwapMode* constants.
Defaults to AutoSwapModeAutoLowestBalance for new orgs.

chainId.description: ChainID is the source chain to sell from.

id.description: ID is a unique identifier for this source (e.g., "src_abc123").

priority.description: Priority controls order of evaluation (lower = tried first).

slippageBps.description: SlippageBps is the slippage tolerance in basis points. Default 300 (3%).

tokenAddress.description: TokenAddress is the token to sell. Use "native" for native gas tokens.

tokenDecimals.description:
TokenDecimals is the number of decimal places for the token (e.g. 18 for ETH, 6 for USDC).
Stored so the UI can display the human-readable amount without re-fetching on-chain metadata.

walletId.description: WalletID is the org wallet to sell from.

userEmail.description: UserEmail is resolved from B3 API at response time and not persisted.

default.description: Default value (used if not provided at runtime)

type.description: string, number, integer, boolean, array, object

inputType.description: address, recipientAddress, tokenAmount, text (see frontend CELL_REGISTRY)

accountType.description:
AccountType filters the wallet picker by account type on
inputType="walletConnector" fields (e.g. "polymarket_deposit_wallet").

allowWalletPicker.description:
AllowWalletPicker controls the org-wallet picker on inputType="address"
fields. When false, the frontend hides the inline "Wallets" badge and
the org-wallet autocomplete popover. Use for third-party address fields
(e.g. a deployer filter) where suggesting org wallets is misleading.
Pointer so explicit false survives JSON round-trip (default true on FE).

allowedChannels.description:
AllowedChannels constrains the notification-channel picker
(inputType: "notification-channel") to a subset of channels. Used by
templates whose downstream nodes only work with one channel type
(e.g. ["slack"] for a Slack-only approval flow). Frontend ignores
unknown keys; a length-1 list auto-selects in the picker.

autoFillFromWallet.description:
AutoFillFromWallet, when true, auto-fills this prop with the selected
workflow wallet address and hides it from the form. Pointer so an
explicit false survives the JSON round-trip (same rationale as
AllowWalletPicker).

bindsConnectorNodes.description:
BindsConnectorNodes lists workflow node IDs whose wallet-type connector
should be prefilled from this prop's picked wallet (inputType:
"walletConnector"). The connector stays a plain, editable connector —
this is a prefill, not a permanent bind.

chainPropKey.description: For tokenSelector/tokenAmount: prop key providing chainId

columns.description:
Columns describes a csvTable prop (inputType: "csvTable"). The stored
value is an object-of-columnar-arrays: {colKey: []value}. Payload
templates reference each column via {{$props.<propKey>.<colKey>}}.

dex.description: For hyperliquidAsset: hardcoded DEX name (fallback when no dexPropKey)

dexPropKey.description: For hyperliquidAsset: prop key providing HIP-3 DEX name

excludeNative.description: For tokenSelector/multiTokenSelector: hide native tokens (field only accepts ERC-20 contract addresses)

groupKey.description: Groups related props for unified UI rendering

inputType.description:
InputType is a UI rendering hint. The frontend uses it to pick a rich
selector component instead of a plain text input. Unknown values are
silently ignored (falls back to default input).
Valid values: chainSelector, tokenSelector, multiTokenSelector, tokenAmount,
coinSelector, multiCoinSelector, address, contractAddress, recipientAddress,
email, telegram-chat, slack-channel, pushover-recipient, pushbullet-device,
webpush-subscription, textarea, password, polymarketUser, twitterUsername,
storkAsset, hyperliquidAsset, morphoVault, morphoMarket, csvTable,
notification-channel, googleSheetUrl, rrule, walletConnector

maxRows.description: csvTable: maximum allowed rows (0 = no cap)

showWalletBalances.description: For tokenSelector: show wallet balances (useful for "sell" tokens)

sources.description:
Sources lists the workflow node fields this prop was created from.
Each entry identifies a node + field path so the frontend can
reliably match props back to their source fields on reload.
Multiple entries indicate the prop was merged from fields with
identical values across different nodes.

tokenAddressPropKey.description: For tokenAmount: prop key providing tokenAddress

github_com_b3-fun_b3-mono_services_b3os-.description:
Summary drives the csvTable footer summary. Nil means no summary is
rendered. See PropSchemaSummary for details.

aggregates.description: Aggregates declared in display order, left-to-right.

position.description:
Position in the grid. "footer" (default) renders inline under the
table. "none" suppresses even when aggregates are declared — use to
disable inherited summaries. Other values reserved.

label.description:
Optional override for the displayed label. If empty, the frontend
derives a label from the column + reducer (e.g. "Total amount").

reduce.description:
Reducer name. Matches the key in the frontend cell-spec's
`aggregate` map (currently: "sum", "count"). Unknown reducers are
silently skipped on the frontend.

github_com_b3-fun_b3-mono_services_b3os-.description:
VisibleWhen controls conditional visibility: show this prop only when
the referenced prop has the specified value.

buttonLabel.description: ButtonLabel is the text displayed on the trigger button

description.description: Description explains what the workflow does

enabled.description: Enabled controls whether the public widget is active

maxAmount.description: MaxAmount is the maximum amount allowed per trigger (in smallest unit)

minAmount.description: MinAmount is the minimum amount required to trigger (in smallest unit)

title.description: Title is the display title for the widget

totalCu.description: Not a column; populated by service

x-enum-comments.RunStatusPartial: Run completed with mixed for-each iteration outcomes
x-enum-comments.RunStatusWaiting: Run is paused, waiting for a trigger to resume

count.description: Scope-dependent: template, action, trigger, or connector count

generatedAppId.description:
Generated-app attachment (nil when the template ships no app). On
adoption the referenced app is CLONED into the adopting org's new
workflow. GeneratedAppVersionID optionally pins a specific version
whose manifest is used as the clone source.

organizationId.description: Fields for user-generated templates (nil for built-in templates)

sourceWorkflowId.description: Source workflow link (nil for built-in or legacy templates)

github_com_b3-fun_b3-mono_services_b3os-.description:
Moderation fields (B3-4168). Only meaningful for public templates;
org templates are always approved.

bucketStart.description: Start of time bucket (hourly or daily)

usageCount.description: Number of executions in this bucket

hasDraft.description:
Response-only fields (not persisted to database)
HasDraft indicates a draft exists (for live workflows in API responses)

hasLiveVersion.description: HasLiveVersion indicates a live version exists (for drafts in API responses)

versionCreatedBy.description:
VersionCreatedBy is the user who authored THIS version row. Unlike
CreatedBy (asset creator, copied to every version for ownership) and
UpdatedBy (overwritten by lifecycle ops like archiving), it is stamped
once at version insert and never mutated.

github_com_b3-fun_b3-mono_services_b3os-.description:
Definition is the inline workflow graph to analyze. Same shape as a
saved workflow's definition. Unlike the ephemeral-run endpoint there
is no trigger restriction — analysis is read-only and method-agnostic.

blockExpansions.description: Set on run snapshots only (not workflow DB)

sensitivePropKeys.description: Legacy: kept for old runs; no longer populated for new workflows

triggerNodeIds.description:
TriggerNodeIDs lists the node IDs that are trigger (root) nodes. Every
workflow declares this — single-trigger workflows ship ["root"] (the
legacy node id), multi-trigger workflows list every trigger node id.
Treating single-trigger as a forest-of-1 removes the two-path branching
throughout the BE + FE; older rows without the field are backfilled by
migration 000282 and the field-missing path stays as a read-side safety
net (see FindTriggerNodeIDs) but is no longer exercised by saves.

"root" is also a runtime alias for "the trigger that fired this run" —
{{root.X}} variable references resolve to the firing trigger regardless
of which trigger fired. Don't repurpose the literal "root" as a trigger
id on a multi-trigger workflow.

variableDefs.description:
VariableDefs is a snapshot of the workflow's declared variables at run
creation time. The canonical source lives on the workflows row
(Workflow.VariableDefs column). Snapshotted into the run definition
so the worker can resolve {{$vars.x}} lookups and route variable-action
writes to the right scope without an extra DB round trip.

loopBody.description: Loop body nodes (only for for-each nodes)

resultSchema.description:
ResultSchema describes the output structure of this node (populated dynamically for x402 endpoints).
This is used by the frontend to show available output variables in the variable picker.

titleOverride.description: AI-generated short title (2-6 words), only when more descriptive than default

chainId.description: Chain ID where payment should be made (e.g., 8453 for Base)

discoverable.description:
Discoverable controls whether this workflow is listed in the Bazaar public catalog.
Bazaar is a discovery marketplace where users can find and pay for x402-enabled endpoints.
When true:  Endpoint is publicly listed, anyone can trigger with payment only (no secret needed).
When false: Endpoint is private, requires both secret and payment to trigger.

price.description: Price in the smallest unit of the token (e.g., wei for ETH, 6 decimals for USDC)

recipient.description: Recipient address that will receive the payment

description.description: Description provides details about what the workflow does

logo.description: Logo URL for the workflow/provider logo

name.description: Name is the display name for the workflow

provider.description: Provider is the name of the entity providing this workflow

example.description: Example provides a sample value for documentation and testing

schema.description: Schema is a JSON Schema definition for validation

baseUrl.description:
=== ENDPOINT IDENTITY ===
BaseURL is the clean URL without query params (e.g., "https://api.example.com/search")

defaultQueryParams.description: Default values (applied if user doesn't provide at runtime)

queryParams.description:
=== INPUT CONFIGURATION ===
CDP-aligned flat structure: {"paramName": {"type": "string", "description": "...", "required": true}}

x-enum-comments.X402EndpointSourceCDPBazaar: Imported from CDP Bazaar discovery API

body.description: Body contains JSON Schema for body parameters (used by some x402 providers)

bodyFields.description: BodyFields contains body field definitions in alternative CDP format

bodyParams.description: BodyParams contains body param definitions in CDP format

query.description: Query contains JSON Schema for query parameters (used by some x402 providers)

queryParams.description: QueryParams contains query param definitions in CDP format

chainId.description: ChainID is the chain ID for EIP-712 domain (from quote)

facilitatorAddress.description: FacilitatorAddress is the facilitator's address that will be approved as spender

signatureType.description: SignatureType specifies the signature method: "authorization" (EIP-3009) or "permit" (ERC-2612)

verifyingContract.description: VerifyingContract is the token contract address for EIP-712 domain (from quote)

version.description: Version is the ERC20 token version (used in EIP-712 domain)

amount.description:
Amount is the v2 equivalent of MaxAmountRequired.
During normalization, Amount is copied to MaxAmountRequired
if MaxAmountRequired is empty.

srcTokenAddress.description: Cross-token payment fields (set when buyer uses X-PREFERRED-TOKEN)

agentType.description: AgentType is the registry key passed back as StartAgentRunParams.AgentType.

serves.description:
Serves is true when the agent produces a browser-openable artifact
(a report or app) at the run's served URL.

defaultWalletAddress.description:
DefaultWalletAddress overrides the wallet used when a node has no
explicit connector or payload wallet field. When empty, the org's
default wallet is used (same fallback as the saved-workflow path).

chainId.description: ChainID is the source chain to sell from.

id.description: ID is a stable identifier for this source. Leave empty to auto-generate on create.

priority.description: Priority controls evaluation order (lower = tried first).

slippageBps.description: SlippageBps is the swap slippage tolerance in basis points (0-8000). Default 300 (3%).

tokenAddress.description: TokenAddress is the token to sell. Use "native" for native gas tokens or a 0x address.

tokenDecimals.description: TokenDecimals is the number of decimal places for the token (e.g. 18 for ETH, 6 for USDC). UI only.

walletId.description: WalletID is the org wallet to sell tokens from.

agentVersion.description: Optional - agent version toggle; "v3" routes to the caddie service (open to every org)

apiKeyOverride.description: Optional - override the LLM API key for this request (eval/testing use only)

conversationId.description: Stable conversation identifier (generated client-side, persists across session→workflow transition)

images.description: Optional - images attached to the message (base64 for LLM, IPFS for storage)

lastEventIndex.description: Last received event index for replay (reconnection)

message.description: Optional on reconnect, required for new sessions

modelOverride.description: Optional - override the LLM model for this request (eval/testing use only)

preferredMode.description: Optional - user's preferred mode hint; overrides auto-classifier when set

requestId.description: Client-generated UUID4 for persistent session tracking (optional for legacy/inline mode)

sessionId.description: Optional - metadata: which create-page session started this conversation

temperatureOverride.description: Optional - override the LLM temperature for this request (eval/testing use only)

templateSearchMode.description: Optional - template search mode toggle (defaults to lightweight)

timezone.description: Optional - user's IANA timezone (e.g. "America/New_York") for time-aware responses

workflowId.description: Optional - metadata: which workflow this conversation is about

contextType.description: ContextType indicates whether this is a "session" or "workflow" chat

conversationId.description: ConversationID for V3 sessions (stable thread identifier)

firstMessageAt.description: FirstMessageAt is when the first message was sent

lastMessageAt.description: LastMessageAt is when the last message was sent

messageCount.description: MessageCount is the total number of messages in this session

preview.description: Preview is the content of the first user message (truncated)

sessionId.description: SessionID for create-page sessions (client-generated, e.g., session_1234567890_abc)

workflowName.description: WorkflowName is the name of the associated workflow (if available)

contractId.description: ContractID is the primary identifier (optional for first message - backend creates project)

isActive.description:
IsActive is true only when a turn is ACTIVELY running, derived from the
LangGraph checkpoint (not the in-process lock). A turn paused at an
interrupt is NOT active — it is waiting for the user.

pendingInterrupt.description:
PendingInterrupt is the ASK / clarification / template_gate payload that
drives the "Waiting for your input" card, or null when nothing is pending.
Opaque to Go — passed straight through from caddie to the FE.

key.description: Key is the full plaintext API key, shown only once. Store it securely.

installs.description: Keep `max` in sync with MaxInstallsPerSession (validator tags must be literals).

conversationId.description: Optional: conversation that created this workflow

sessionId.description: Optional: migrate chat history from session to workflow

templateId.description: Optional: template ID to track fork count

defaultQueryParams.description: Default values (applied if user doesn't provide at runtime)

queryParams.description:
Input configuration (CDP-aligned flat structure)
Format: {"paramName": {"type": "string", "description": "...", "required": true}}

payload.description:
Payload is merged into the trigger result (root node output),
accessible via {{root.result.key}} expressions. A "triggeredAt"
timestamp is always added automatically.

propValues.description:
PropValues are template parameter values injected into the run
context, accessible via {{$props.key}} expressions.

runId.description:
RunID is an optional client-generated run ID. Must start with
"run_" prefix. If omitted, a run ID is generated server-side.
Use this to subscribe to SSE stream before triggering the run.

description.description: Description is a short summary of what the workflow does.

name.description: Name is the display name of the workflow.

workflowName.description: WorkflowName is the display name of the workflow

name.description: Optional: User can override AI-generated values

walletAddress.description:
Optional: Specify which wallet to use for payment.
If not provided, uses the organization's default wallet.

user_id.description:
UserID is the caller's resolved user identifier — surfaced so the
frontend can scope per-user client state (e.g., the Path B
localStorage gate) without a separate /me round trip.

claimed_at.description:
claimed_at + claimed_by intentionally NOT omitempty — emit `null` for
pending tasks so the TS frontend gets a stable shape (`string | null`,
never `undefined`). See useIncentiveState.ts type IncentiveTaskState.

reason_code.description:
ReasonCode is the typed bucket the verifier set on a failure
(FailureClass enum, see incentive/types.go). Frontend should branch on
this typed value rather than substring-matching `Reason` copy.
Empty when Status="claimed".

allowed.description: Allowed is false when the org has no AI credits left (ledger balance <= 0).

body.description:
Optional body to send with the probe request.
Some endpoints require valid input before returning 402.

method.description:
Optional HTTP method to use. If not specified, tries POST then GET.
Valid values: GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE

PublicWidgetData.description: Widget contains the public widget configuration with derived trigger values

buttonLabel.description: ButtonLabel is the text displayed on the trigger button

chainId.description: ChainID is derived from the trigger's chainId

description.description: Description explains what the workflow does

enabled.description: Enabled controls whether the public widget is active

maxAmount.description: MaxAmount is the maximum amount allowed per trigger (in smallest unit)

minAmount.description: MinAmount is the minimum amount required to trigger (in smallest unit)

recipientAddress.description: RecipientAddress is derived from the trigger's toAddress/contractAddress

title.description: Title is the display title for the widget

tokenAddress.description: TokenAddress is derived from the trigger's tokenAddress (empty for native token)

expectedVersion.description:
ExpectedVersion, when set, makes the workflow publish step fail with a
version conflict if the draft has moved on — optimistic locking,
mirrors PublishWorkflowParams.

buttonLabel.description: ButtonLabel is the text displayed on the trigger button (optional, defaults to "Send")

description.description: Description explains what the workflow does (optional)

maxAmount.description: MaxAmount is the maximum amount allowed per trigger (optional)

minAmount.description: MinAmount is the minimum amount required to trigger (optional)

title.description: Title is the display title for the widget (required)

braintrustSpanId.description:
BraintrustSpanID is the turn's Braintrust span id, persisted to the
ledger so the admin dashboard can deep-link a charge to its trace.

workflowVersion.description:
WorkflowVersion is the workflow version to revert to. The resulting
release records this version.

chatMessageId.description: Optional assistant chat message that launched this run.

dustTest.description:
When true, run with auto-calculated dust amounts (~$0.01 USD).
Mutually exclusive with Simulate.

runId.description:
Optional run ID. If provided, must start with "run_" prefix.
Use this to subscribe to SSE stream before triggering the run.

simulate.description: When true, run the workflow in simulation mode (dry-run).

triggerNodeId.description:
For multi-trigger ("forest") workflows: which trigger node should be
recorded as the firing trigger for this run. Optional — when omitted
the workflow's manual trigger is resolved by type, matching the
historical single-trigger behavior. The trigger picker in the editor
sends this so the resulting run is attributed to the trigger the user
actually clicked.

version.description:
Optional version number. When set, run this specific version instead of
the default (which prioritizes draft). Useful for testing the live version
while a draft exists.

agentVersion.description: Caddie lane that produced this debug payload (defaults to v2 when empty)
empty defaults to v2 at the column level

createdAt.description:
CreatedAt lets the caller stamp the row's timestamp explicitly. caddie sets
it on the USER row to the moment the message was received (turn start), so
its created_at reflects when the user actually sent it rather than the
turn-end persist moment (the assistant row omits it → DB now()). Nil → the
chat_messages.created_at column default (now()) applies.

structuredPayload.description: Phase 2A typed payload — persisted to chat_messages.structured_payload (bounded by caddie)

AgentType selects which registered first-party agent to run. Required —
the caller picks one from GET /v1/agent-runs/agents (the worker's
enabled-agent discovery list). There is no default: routing an empty type
to a fixed agent risks dispatching to a disabled one (an opaque 403).

conversationId.description:
Optional. Threads the run into an existing agent conversation; when empty
the server generates a fresh conversation id (an independent thread).

payload.description:
Payload is agent-type-specific input passed opaquely to the runtime
(e.g. app-builder build params: workflowId, manifest, archetypeHint,
parentBuildId, recentBuilds). workflow-builder ignores it.

transaction.description: May be null if server doesn't return it

enabled.description: Enabled turns the feature on or off for the org.

maxSwapAmountUsd.description: MaxSwapAmountUsd caps each individual swap's output USD value. 0 = no limit.

mode.description:
Mode controls how sources are selected. Valid values: "manual",
"auto_highest_balance", "auto_lowest_balance". Defaults to "auto_lowest_balance".

sources.description: Sources is the ordered list of token sources to try when a balance top-up is needed.

skipAIGeneration.description:
SkipAIGeneration is accepted for backward compatibility but ignored:
the server decides AI regeneration from the node-graph diff, not a hint.

code.description: Optional stable machine code for consumers to branch on (e.g. pure_variable_type_mismatch)

type.description: name, nodes, root, connectivity, pattern, variable

contractAddress.description: Optional - uses address from deployment if not provided

turnkeyRootUserId.description:

Only populated for the import-wallet flow; do not rely on it in other consumers.

inputCount.description:
Count of definition.inputSchema entries — powers the "N inputs"
badge in WorkflowSelector without a detail fetch.

linkedWorkflowIds.description:
IDs referenced by any trigger-workflow node — lets useLinkedWorkflows
build the incoming/outgoing link graph from the slim list.

NodeTypes is the flat list of every node type (trigger + actions); the

TriggerTypes lists the type of EVERY trigger (root) node. For
single-trigger workflows this is a one-element slice matching
TriggerType. For forest (multi-trigger) workflows it carries all
trigger types so the tab strip can show "2 triggers → Swap" instead
of silently representing only the first trigger.

availableTypes.description:
AvailableTypes / AvailableConnectors are the distinct trigger-type and
connector-type values that exist in the org's workflows under the
current filter context (ignoring status — same scope as the counts
above). Frontend uses these to populate the filter-panel dropdowns so
users can pick from every option in the full result set, not just the
current visible page.
